texts: A few Keepers keep a notebook of moth-counts and weather notes.
Whenever an heir inherits a Keeper's lantern-station, that heir inherits that Keeper's notebook.

fields.sentence: A few Keepers keep a notebook of moth-counts and weather notes.

q1_issues.issue: The per-member distribution rule reuses the single indefinite witness sk_notebook_1, so it asserts that every Keeper in the group keeps that same one notebook — the collective reading licenses no rule at all, and the distributive reading requires a per-binding Skolem object (sk_notebook $x) as in the doctrine's dependent-existential pattern.

q2_gaps: Contentful / 'about' of-phrase on a concrete, non-nominalization, non-relational noun ('a notebook OF moth-counts and weather notes'): the possessive-genitive section explicitly excludes an about-phrase ('a photo of Mary') from Possession but names no replacement encoding, and the nominalization Of-oblique is scoped to nouns with an underlying verb — so the whole of-phrase (and both coordinated compounds) is unrepresentable and is dropped here.

Capitalized plural kind-word label under a quantifier ('a few Keepers'): the capitalized-common-noun default is stated as 'singular-collective only', and the Name-only plural rule is stated only for a plural 'referring as a name' ('the Wrens'), leaving a quantified capitalized plural unrouted between kind-typing and Name-only individual.
review.notes: Group witness + CardinalityPhrase "a few", the group event alongside the per-member rule, the Theme role for keep, and the unmarked habitual tense are all correct; the sole encoding fault is the shared notebook symbol inside the rule.

issues.reason: With no "the same"/"a certain" cue the scope default is subject-wide (the doctrine's dependent-existential pattern, "every student read some book" -> (Theme (sk_read $x) (sk_book $x))), so reusing the constant sk_notebook_1 inside the per-member rule asserts one single notebook kept by every member of the group, which the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: Contentful/about of-phrase on a concrete, non-nominalization, non-relational noun ("a notebook OF moth-counts and weather notes"): Possession is explicitly barred for an about-phrase and the Of-oblique is scoped to nouns with an underlying verb, so no carrier is licensed and the restriction is dropped.

Quantified capitalized plural kind-word label ("a few Keepers"): the capitalized-common-noun default is stated as singular-collective only, and the Name-only plural rule covers only a plural referring AS a name, leaving a quantified capitalized plural unrouted.
new_gaps: When a vague/counted plural's distributive predicate takes a DEPENDENT indefinite object, the group-event half that Cardinality keeps alongside the per-member rule has no licensed object filler: a single witness there (Theme sk_keep_1 sk_notebook_1) asserts one shared notebook at group level, and no group-side counterpart of the Skolem-function object is defined.
adjudication.defect_summary: The rule's object must be the per-binding Skolem term - (Theme (sk_keep $x) (sk_notebook $x)) with (Member (sk_notebook $x) notebook) as a conjunct inside the same conclusion - rather than the shared constant sk_notebook_1.
adjudication.notes: The group witness, the CardinalityPhrase "a few", the Theme role for keep and the unmarked habitual tense are all correct; only the object's binding inside the rule fails.

fields.sentence: Whenever an heir inherits a Keeper's lantern-station, that heir inherits that Keeper's notebook.
parse: (: heir_inherit_whenever (Implication (And (Member $h heir) (Member $k keeper) (Member $e inherit) (Agent $e $h) (Theme $e $ls) (Member $ls lantern_station) (Possession $ls $k)) (And (Member (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) inherit) (Agent (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) $h) (Theme (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) (sk_notebook $k)) (Member (sk_notebook $k) notebook) (Possession (sk_notebook $k) $k) (During (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's Skolem event is indexed as (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) rather than by the trigger occurrence $e, so it is not the required per-occurrence event: two distinct qualifying inheritances by the same heir from the same Keeper collapse into one event that is then During both triggers, contrary to the whenever pattern's (sk_bark $x) indexing and the rule that a dependent existential is a Skolem function of every universal scoping over it.

review.notes: Everything else checks out: lantern_station genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed, Theme for inherit, Possession (possessed first) for both genitives, no QuantifierPhrase for whenever, keeper as a plain kind (referring use, so no agent-nominalization capability atom). (Inheritance notebook book) is a borderline call under the solid-spelling clause but defensible since note+head is transparent and the IS-A holds.

issues.reason: The whenever machinery mandates "the response as a Skolem event per occurrence, tied to its trigger with During" and indexes it on the trigger variable ((sk_bark $x) over the ring event $x), and the multi-quantifier rule makes a dependent existential "a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it" — (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k) omits the trigger event $e, so one consequent event can be During two distinct qualifying station-inheritances, which no single event can truly be.

adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form indexes the consequent event on the trigger occurrence — (sk_inherit_notebook $e) (or (sk_inherit_notebook $h $k $e), a function of every scoping universal) with (During (sk_inherit_notebook $e) $e) — everything else in the rule unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The rest is clean: lantern_station/notebook genus atoms with the noun modifiers correctly unexposed, Theme for inherit, Possession possessed-first for both genitives, no QuantifierPhrase (whenever is a frequency conditional), and (sk_notebook $k) rightly covaries with the Keeper alone.
